kicker.zh: 型号 / 接口 / 材料

intro.en: Find a cable model or material part number, then send it for a custom replacement or original-part sourcing review.
intro.zh: 按成品型号或材料料号查找，提交编号即可沟通兼容替代件制作或原厂件采购。

search_label.en: Find a model or part number

search_placeholder.en: Brand, model, part number or product type
search_placeholder.zh: 输入品牌、型号、料号或产品类型

empty.en: No matching references. Try a brand, full part number or a listed alias.
empty.zh: 未找到匹配项，请尝试品牌、完整料号或已列出的别名。

intro.en: Finished cable and harness references for this interface or application.
intro.zh: 此接口或应用方向的成品电缆与线束参考。

intro.en: Connector, wire and process-material references for project selection.
intro.zh: 供项目选型的连接器、线材与工艺材料参考。

copy.en: Match each wire number to the terminal schedule and controller I/O list. Record whether connector views show the mating face or wire-entry side before freezing the pin map.
copy.zh: 把每个线号对应到端子表与控制器I/O清单，并在冻结针脚表前注明接口图采用对插面还是进线面视图。

copy.en: Use door opening angle, hinge position and cable anchoring points to define a movement loop. Check branch reach with the door both open and closed.
copy.zh: 依据柜门开启角度、铰链位置与固定点定义运动余量，并在柜门开启和关闭两种状态下核对分支长度。

copy.en: Mark power, relay-switching and sensitive signal branches on the layout. Define twisted pairs, shield exits and ground termination with the controller and cabinet design.
copy.zh: 在布局图上标出动力、继电器开关与敏感信号分支，并配合控制器及柜体设计定义双绞、屏蔽出线与接地端接。

title.zh: 管形端头与端子操作空间

copy.en: Confirm conductor size, ferrule barrel length and terminal clamping range together. Leave access for the specified screwdriver, connector latch and later replacement.
copy.zh: 一起确认导体规格、管形端头管长与端子夹持范围，并为指定螺丝刀、接口卡扣和后续更换预留操作空间。

copy.en: Select duct size and branch exits from the actual bundle and installation sequence. Keep wire numbers readable after ducts, sleeves and retainers are installed.
copy.zh: 根据实际线束束径和安装顺序选择线槽尺寸与分支出口，安装线槽、套管和挡线件后仍需能辨认线号。

copy.en: State which parts arrive fitted and which are installed by the customer. Approve a fixture or actual-panel fit check, terminal locations and continuity record for the first article.
copy.zh: 明确哪些部件预装交付、哪些由客户安装，并为首件确认工装或实物面板适配检查、端子位置与导通记录。

boundary.en: Send the part number, drawing or sample to confirm the replacement configuration and sourcing plan.
boundary.zh: 请提供型号、图纸或样品，具体替代配置与原厂件采购方案按项目确认。

text.en: Send the model or part number to discuss your project.
text.zh: 提交型号或料号，沟通您的定制与采购需求。
